components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ballpen blue: anything you act on.

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Outlined in the current ink for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { background: transparent; color: #1d1a16; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 3px; font: 600 14px 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: rgb(0 0 0 / .05); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f3c9e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Typed Field
components.css: .ds-cap { display: block; font: 650 11px 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-stretch: 85%; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5d554a; } .ds-field { display: block; width: 100%; border: 0; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #e3ddd2; background: transparent; padding: 6px 2px; font: 16px 'Courier Prime', monospace; color: #1d1a16; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #6f665a; } .ds-field:hover { border-bottom-color: color-mix(in oklab, #1f3c9e 40%, #e3ddd2); } .ds-field:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #1f3c9e; }

components.name: Status Stamp
components.description: Violet rubber-stamp ink for any status.

components.name: Skill Tab
components.description: Typed paper tab on the envelope; off state is dashed and struck through.
components.css: .ds-env { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; padding: 12px; background: #8e5f2e; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-tab { padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 2px; border: 0; background: #fff; color: #1d1a16; font: 13px 'Courier Prime', monospace; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgb(46 29 12 / .3); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-off { background: transparent; color: #fbf1e2; border: 1px dashed rgb(251 241 226 / .6); box-shadow: none; text-decoration: line-through; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f3c9e; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Every Filipino job applicant has carried one: the long brown envelope with a string-and-button clasp, holding a resume, a bio-data sheet and a 2x2 photo. The app is that envelope. Kraft paper is the ground and the chrome. Each user's profile is their envelope, with the resume slip sticking out of its mouth. Jobs are white long-bond slips laid on the kraft, and each one is rubber-stamped with how well it matches. The admin reads sign-ups as a logbook of received applications.

This is an operating surface, so the world lives in its materials and marks, not in decoration. Every page is still a familiar app layout: a header, a profile column and a list. The kraft fibre, the clasp, the stamps and the typed entries are what make it this product. Density is moderate: slips are readable at a glance, and the best match is singled out by one big stamp rather than by colour.
keyCharacteristics: Kraft ground, white paper on top, one ink per job: ballpen blue acts, violet stamps status, red string ties and warns.
Rubber stamps (condensed caps, ink grain, a slight tilt) carry every status: match, best match, new, open to PH, admin, received.
Courier Prime appears only where something is typed onto a form: field entries, skill tabs, emails, dates.
Authored SVG for the clasp, the flap seam and the paper fibre. No stock imagery and no glyph icons.

rules.name: The One Ink, One Job Rule
rules.body: Blue acts, violet states, red ties or destroys. A status is never blue and an action is never violet. NEW is violet, not red.

rules.name: The Two Browns Rule
rules.body: The envelope stays a visible shade deeper than the ground (`envelope` on `kraft-ground`). Text on the envelope is cream; text on the ground is near-black. Never put dark ink on the envelope, because it fails contrast.

rules.name: The Typewriter Rule
rules.body: Courier is for what was typed onto the form, never for counts, summaries, names in chrome or lists of skills inside running text. Those are Archivo with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Paper Stack Rule
rules.body: Only paper casts shadows, and the shadow is always brown and offset downward. Controls, stamps and the header are flat; the header is set off by a 2px printed edge, not a shadow.

dos: **Do** put every status in a stamp in violet ink, condensed caps with grain and a slight tilt.
**Do** keep text on the envelope cream (`envelope-ink`) and text on the ground near-black (`kraft-ink`).
**Do** use Courier Prime only for typed entries, tabs, emails and dates.
**Do** credit the source board with a followed link on every job, and send "View posting" to the original URL.
**Do** fold secondary controls behind a disclosure on phones so that the first job is visible.
donts: **Don't** stamp NEW or any status in red. Red is for the string and for destructive actions.
**Don't** give stamps an opaque fill. The ink sits directly on whatever is underneath, paper or kraft.
**Don't** turn slips into cards with icon headers, coloured side borders or hover lifts.
**Don't** use hard offset (zero-blur) shadows. The header's edge is a 2px border.
**Don't** use emoji or Unicode glyphs as icons. Use Lucide or authored SVG.
